caption:
Talking to a camera isn't easy for any business owner. It takes reps, every single day.

I've done it for over 10 years, and clients still tell me they found me through one of my videos.

Comment IDEAS and I'll send you 10 video ideas you can film this week.
why: It opens with Joseph's own blunt point that confidence on camera comes from reps, backs it with facts he states in the video (over 10 years on camera, clients who found him through his videos), and uses IDEAS because the video tells business owners to start filming.
